messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT 1771000000 - inference-prod: sustained 5xx spike on /v1/generate, paging @sre-oncall-tj :rotating_light:

sre-oncall-tj: saw it, moving to the incident channel. i'm oncall, starting triage. ETA 5m for first check.

maya: can you share which region and model variants?

sre-oncall-tj: us-west-2, model=rw-13b-q4, spike started ~1770999800, error rate ~7% over 5m (baseline 0.2%).

alex: logs show many "kv cache miss" + OOM-ish traces from runtime, not straight 500 body errors though. past 10m we've had steady prefix cache eviction.

liam: i'm checking runtime side — we rolled a small idle-kernel change 2h ago that touches memory accounting. rolling back is an option but need safe window.

maya: immediate mitigation options: 1) scale up dedicated capacity pool, 2) temporarily route traffic to fallback model (rw-7b) via routing policy, 3) disable the new kernel flag. which is lowest blast radius?

liam: disabling kernel flag is safe and fast (no model restarts), i'll open the toggle now.

ops-bot: toggle change request: disable_feature("kernel_memory_prefs_v2") by liam — approved, triggering rollout to us-west-2.

sre-oncall-tj: rolling, will monitor 2m windows.

[~2m later]

sre-oncall-tj: partial improvement — 5xx dropped from 7% to 2.1% in last 5m. still above baseline.

maya: good. can we also cut some alert noise before we converge on root cause? our 5xx paging threshold is a flat 0.5% for all models which is noisy for lower-capacity variants.

alex: agreed. current alert fires on query: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[5m])) > 0.005 — need to add model and region-level baselines.

maya: proposing: per-model thresholding with minimum absolute counts. e.g., if total_requests < 2000 in 5m, require absolute 50 5xx to page. Also add an 'error_budget_burn' metric so we can page on SLO burn not raw rate.

liam: +1 for SLO burn. metric would be: slo_burn = (5xx_rate / slo_threshold) over 1h window. if burn > 4 -> page.

rachel: for retrospectives we should build a dashboard that surfaces: golden signals, error budget burn, model-level request heatmap, KV cache miss rate, kernel toggle deployments, and routing-fallback counts. Drilldowns to traces and tail logs per model.

maya: let's sketch panels:
- panel A: cluster-wide 5xx pct (p50/p95 request latencies overlay)
- panel B: per-model 5xx pct + request volume heatmap
- panel C: error_budget_burn (1h, 6h) with annotations for deploys/toggles
- panel D: kv_cache_miss_rate and cache_eviction_count
- panel E: routing_fallback_count and fallback_latency
- panel F: top calling customers (api_key hash) by error rate

alex: include a small panel with the current oncall + handoff history and a link to the runbook. also add an annotation strip for incident start/mitigation steps.

liam: prometheus snippets for the panels:
```
# per-model 5xx pct
(sum by(model) (rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[5m]))) / (sum by(model) (rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[5m]))) * 100

# kv cache miss rate
(sum by(model) (rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m]))) / (sum by(model) (rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))) * 100
```

maya: for annotations use ops-bot to post when toggles/deploys happen. ops-bot: can you add a grafana annotation event on toggle changes?

ops-bot: will do — sending annotation event for disable_feature("kernel_memory_prefs_v2") at 1771000105.

sre-oncall-tj: current status: incident mitigated to "degraded". still watching. moving to post-incident lane. handing off to rachel for dashboard build and alert tuning. rachel, you're up — accept?

rachel: taking it. i'll create a dashboard template in grafana under dashboards/incidents/inference-postmortem and add the panels maya suggested. timeline: initial draft by EOD. I'll also open a PR to alerting with per-model thresholds + SLO-burn rules.

maya: assign owners for follow-ups:
- alert rules PR: rachel
- dashboard JSON + panels: rachel + alex (panel styles/traces)
- runtime rollback/blame RCA: liam + alex
- SLO definition update: maya + product (cc @rachel)

alex: quick note on drilldowns — add links from panel to traces UI with template var: ?var-model=$model&var-preset=last_30m so ops can jump straight to trace samples.

liam: also add a small latency percentile panel that computes tail compaction ratio (p99/p50) so we can see tail degradation when cache misses spike.

rachel: copy. i'll include p99/p50 panel and the trace links. Will also add a 'mute map' so we can temporarily mute noisy rules per-model without removing them.

sre-oncall-tj: one more oncall handoff note — i'll update the incident log with the customer impact: ~3% of requests had errors at peak, estimated 15 customers saw increased error rates, no data exfil.

maya: perfect. once the dashboard PR is up, let's do a small tabletop to validate the drilldown flow and the annotation visibility.

rachel: PR opened: gitlab.com/redwood/infradev/monitoring/-/merge_requests/424 — dashboard JSON + panel scaffolding. reviewers: maya, alex. tagging for the postmortem doc.

sre-oncall-tj: handing off final watch to rachel at 1771000867. i'll be available if any rollback needed. good job team. :thumbsup:

rachel: thanks — will follow up with timeline and retrospective notes.
